meaning: Bind complete retained native Workflow semantics and audit observations to exact public verification obligations without changing the original standalone adapter or treating interoperability success as a whole-project pass.

construction.scaffold: Embedded agent-navigation scaffold; no DomainSpec relationship admission.
construction.product: Public verification accounts for every Workflow even when the original standalone transport cannot carry the complete finite case family.
construction.business: Consumers can distinguish unsupported evidence, failed behavior and fully observed finite behavior without discarding source cases.
construction.domainspec: One original registered compiled graph and matching reconciled plan, with their exact Workflow selectors, bindings, modules and source-derived obligations.
construction.compiled_system: Original strict native Workflow ESM and its full retained observations, with explicitly identified artifact origins.
construction.implementation: A separately pinned additive evidence binding in the public reconciled verifier; no production effects.

compatibility.original_standalone: Preserve the existing semantic controls, readiness rows, reasons, observation encoding, 4096-case row limit, 65536-case aggregate limit and 8 MiB envelope. Do not rewrite an unavailable adapter row as ready.
compatibility.private_contracts: Preserve the existing private Workflow case/execution definitions and their private-only claim ceilings. This new binding, not a relabeled private result, owns any public obligation discharge.
compatibility.generated_behavior: No generator, Workflow ordering, compensation selection/execution, transaction, Rule, factory or domain behavior changes.
compatibility.installed_source: Before runtime use, add this contract to a pinned installed successor source capsule with exact predecessor entries preserved. No development-directory reads or caller-selected definitions at runtime.
compatibility.defaults: No legacy profile/layout default cutover, release, admission or activation is implied.

registered_only: live retained aggregate and original private Workflow receipt
reject: omitted selectors, cases, dimensions, batches or audit facets
stale source, native artifacts, tools, declarations or retained files
binding_identity: complete recipes, ordered case identities and coverage dimensions
exact source/native audit profiles and path sets
native observation and retained manifest identities

semantic_evidence.source_family: Use the complete registered source-derived Workflow protocol controls for each exact selector. Preserve search metadata, all cases and dimensions, wrapper/material descriptor observations and original call identity. Source preparation alone cannot discharge an obligation.
semantic_evidence.observation: Require the successful registered private execution over every batch and case, including exact hashes of the complete actual semantic observation. Expected answers must never enter observer inputs.
semantic_evidence.commitment: The existing encoding hashes the entire canonical observation: outcome, recovery identities, batches, port/read/clock traces, await observations and mutation/getter checks. Its SHA-256 collision-resistance assumption remains explicit; it is finite differential evidence, not universal proof.
semantic_evidence.capacity: Reuse the existing private whole-family and per-batch limits unchanged. Unsupported source witnesses, over-capacity whole families and unobserved rows remain explicit. Never select a smaller prefix.
semantic_evidence.non_substitution: A retained Workflow only supplies its own semantic obligation. It cannot discharge separate Rule, factory, Operation, Event, Policy, State Machine, Mapping, Query, Interface, Enum or Calculation obligations.

audit_evidence.same_definitions: Require the exact existing public Workflow effect and orchestration definitions and source-derived profiles. Do not infer equivalence from facet names or empty violation lists.
audit_evidence.coverage: Account for every source-selected audit path. When standalone and retained lanes cover overlapping or disjoint paths, retain each origin and require complete union coverage with consistent original source identity. Never promote a ready subset into the whole Workflow audit result.
audit_evidence.artifact_identity: Bind each native observation to the exact bytes actually audited and their original source module. Do not claim that a private native file is the same physical artifact as a standalone emission; report each origin. Any existing public artifact failure remains a failure.
audit_evidence.registration: Use original registered private receipt access through the aggregate custody boundary, or an equivalent registered internal projection. Serialized summary fields alone are insufficient.

public_join.original_evidence: Keep original standalone semantic coverage/results and retained cross-generator coverage visible. Add a separate per-source obligation fulfillment view with its exact evidence origin.
public_join.denominator: Retain every graph node and every Workflow audit obligation, including zero-edge and unavailable roots. Overall selected-generator semantics may pass only when every source node has complete passing applicable evidence.
public_join.failure_precedence: Any actual standalone, native, source, audit or currentness failure remains a failure. A successful alternate lane must not overwrite it. Missing independent obligations remain not_evaluable.
public_join.inapplicable: No Workflow obligations means inapplicable with zero claimed Workflow observations, not a newly observed native pass.
public_join.remaining_output: Safe-output-separate-from-planning and R09-R18 remain independent obligations.

before_discharge: original registered inputs and source manifest
registered retained aggregate and private Workflow receipt
exact complete selected tool and declaration dependencies
currentness.before_cleanup: Revalidate the binding, all contributing receipts, public evidence and full source/tool epoch before owned cleanup. Failed checks revoke every dependent public result.
currentness.after_cleanup: Require successful owned cleanup for the final passing claim. Published report data is explicitly sealed historical evidence; it is not a live reusable retained receipt.
currentness.cycles: Do not make cross-generator execution depend on the public Workflow obligation it is intended to supply. Keep source/native prerequisites, actual retained observation, obligation binding and final currentness ordered without circular evidence.

effects: Definition/preparation is read-only. Eventual execution writes only owned private verification workspaces with bounded fixture ports. No production provider, automatic compensation, user target write, dependency installation, publication or operational authority.

invariants.statement: Only exact current registered source and execution identities can be joined.
Every source node, Workflow case, dimension, batch and required audit path remains accounted for.
Standalone readiness, retained observation, public fulfillment and overall completion are distinct states.
Independent failures and unavailable obligations cannot disappear behind overlapping successful evidence.
Late source, artifact, tool, receipt or cleanup failure revokes dependent passing evidence.
Finite verification and candidate scaffolds grant no authority or release claim.

nodes.meaning: One exact source Workflow whose complete finite semantics require evidence.
An exact facet and source-selected path set requiring original native/source audit observations.
Registered complete native semantics and descriptor/call observations with live artifact custody.
Immutable source-to-receipt identity and obligation coverage; preparation is not fulfillment.
Validate and account for exact observed obligations while preserving independent failures and final prerequisites.

ontology_scaffold.claim_ceiling: Navigation scaffold only. Relation labels are candidate explanatory links, not admitted DomainSpec canonical signatures or generated system ontology.

validation.requirement: For within-capacity scalar models, prove source recipes, cases, dimensions and full semantic commitments agree with the unchanged standalone suite.
Both layouts retain the complete compound model: 12460 Workflow cases, 20279 calls and all audit facets; public Workflow semantic/audit obligations complete while safe-output remains separate.
The changed always-passing Rule fixture retains all 12155 Workflow cases without hiding independent unavailable Rule/factory obligations.
Mixed ready/unavailable Workflows preserve every selector and audit path. A ready row or shared dependency cannot discharge an unavailable Workflow.
Reject cloned, serialized, foreign, omitted and mismatched binding/receipt/case/descriptor/audit identities.
Original native semantic mismatch, omitted/reordered batches, missing audit facets and substituted observations cannot pass.
Later original-source, public-native, retained-file, tool/declaration and cleanup mutations revoke dependent results.
No-Workflow and zero-edge models retain explicit inapplicability and correct complete source denominators.
Preserve predecessor standalone limits, definitions and generated source; installed contract access works without development-directory reads.
Qualify shared public APIs, source/snapshot entry points and actual CLI; independently rerun every affected existing regression. Do not claim R08 or full CLI completion from this lane alone.

claim_ceiling: Candidate definition and finite source-bound public evidence design only. This file does not implement the binding, prove native behavior, close the running qualification, or complete the CLI.
